name: Kanmail
description: SHA256 server-supplied from the same unauthenticated backend as the download; on macOS strips com.apple.quarantine after extracting, suppressing Gatekeeper's first-run signature check.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Kanmail computes SHA-256 and compares it to the hash returned by the same backend response as the download link.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | Kanmail | https://github.com/Oxygem/Kanmail | 2b8330b / 2026-08-22 | Y | N (version *check* runs automatically on startup + every 24h via `EmailsApp.tsx`/`system.ts`, but download+install (`DoUpdate`) only fires when the user clicks "Update Kanmail") | Y | https (`https://backend.kanmail.io`, plain `net/http.Client`, no `InsecureSkipVerify` anywhere in the module — confirmed via grep) | N | hash only — SHA256 of the downloaded binary/zip is checked, but the expected hash is supplied by the **same unauthenticated backend response** that supplies the download link (not an independent/pinned source) | server-supplied/unpinned (hash comes from `backend.GetVersions()`, no separate trust anchor) | `internal/services/app.go:513-556` (`getUpdate()` calls `backend.GetVersions`), `:592-633` (`DoUpdate()` downloads via `client.Get(update.Link)`, computes SHA256, compares to `update.SHA256Sum` from the same response — `:626-627`), `:654-664` (macOS: `ditto -xk` extracts the update **then explicitly runs `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine`** on the new `.app`, removing the mark that would otherwise trigger a Gatekeeper signature/notarization re-check on next launch), `internal/backend/backend.go:12-51` (constants confirm `https://backend.kanmail.io`, no insecure TLS option), `frontend/src/components/emails/EmailsApp.tsx:46-57` (auto-check on mount + 24h interval), `frontend/src/components/emails/Filters.tsx:266-277` (`DoUpdate()` only called from an explicit "Update Kanmail" click) |
